answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 1938 Country: India Title: Are perfuems and deodorants are permissible in Islam as it contains Alcohol Denat? I was told that Alcohol Denat is synthetic and using of it is not najis? Please reply as soon as possible. Question: Are perfuems and deodorants are permissible in Islam as it contains Alcohol Denat? I was told that Alcohol Denat is synthetic and using of it is not najis? Please reply as soon as possible. Thanks Answer ID: 1938 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 705/D=6/K) The perfumes and deodorants are permissible which do not contain alcohol of grapes, raisin, currant or dates; since the commonly available alcohols are not made of above mentioned fruits but from potato, wheat and etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
